acceptance_criteria: 失った結果と再送を区別
scope: Recording a delivery, applying it and marking it processed happen in one transaction. A delivery whose processing was interrupted (its result lost) stays received with no partial effect and is applied when redelivered; a resend of a processed delivery is acknowledged without effect. reconcile() compares the sender's delivery list with the log and names deliveries that never arrived and ones the sender failed to deliver, for redelivery; a missing delivery is never assumed not to have happened.
